newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czechs arrest man with air gun on Pope route - TV.
newsitem.headline: Czechs arrest man with air gun on Pope route - TV.

text.p: Czech police arrested a man carrying an air pistol close to the route Pope John Paul was due to take into Prague on Friday, Prima commercial television reported on Saturday.

Police took the man into custody after he repeatedly tried to step on to the route from Prague airport to the city centre, Prima said. Footage showed him being searched by the police and the pistol on the ground behind him.
Prima quoted a police spokesman as saying the unnamed 22-year-old from Prague had concealed the gun in a holster under his jacket but that the weapon was not loaded.
The man was later released after a caution. The Pope's motorcade passed through the area without incident.
